name: todo-api

dependencies.name: todo-db
dependencies.description: Stores each task (title, optional due date, completed flag, owning user id, timestamps).

dependencies.name: thunder-auth
dependencies.description: Validates the caller's Thunder-issued bearer token and resolves the signed-in user's id used to scope all task access.

description: Ballerina REST API backing the todo webapp: exposes CRUD for the signed-in user's own tasks, including optional due dates, completion state, and sort/filter query support on the list endpoint. Every operation is scoped to the caller's own user id; it never returns or modifies another user's tasks, and it issues no tokens itself.
